name: Hadrian
title: Emperor
summary: Hadrian was Roman emperor from 117 to 138. Hadrian was born in Italica, in the present-day Andalusian province of Seville in southern Spain, an Italic settlement in Hispania Baetica; his gens Aelia came from the town of Hadria in eastern Italy. He was a member of the Nerva–Antonine dynasty.
notes: Hadrian's relationship with Antinous, a Bithynian youth who drowned in the Nile in 130, led to the youth's deification and the founding of Antinoopolis in Egypt. Hadrian was one of the 'Five Good Emperors.' His reign emphasized stability, administration, and cultural patronage over military expansion. | Source: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hadrian
